title: Creating a hangout space entirely with GenAI - Models, Textures, Voice, Music &Dialogue
author: Dreamix_Rich

comments.author: Dreamix_Rich
comments.body:
Some background here - I used to work for Roblox for a number of years and I also solo built a number of games on the platform that have tens of millions of players. I'm now building a UGC gaming platform that puts GenAI at the center of creation. 

Fun Fact - the prompts used to generate all the assets took one of our alpha creators about 2 to 3 minutes to write:

GenAI 3D Models: Deserts, Building, Furniture, Accessories  
GenAI Textures: Walls, Furniture Fabric, Penguin NPC Faces, Menus, Ads  
GenAI Music: Background Music  
GenAI Dialogue & Voice: An Arguing Penguin Couple, TV Ad, Shop Owner 

We're thinking really carefully how can we make UGC game creation even more accessible and so we're doubling down on GenAI. We're still early and so the results are quite modest but considering this experience only took a hobbyist creator on the platform about an hour to to make and publish it shows the potential. We can't wait to see what's going to be possible in a few years.
